defectRemediated: DEF-004 (Moderation Fail-Closed & Semantic Distinction - Unconfigured Provider Silent Approval Fix)
rootCauseAnalysis: In apps/api/src/services/contentModeration.ts, when no external moderation provider was configured (OPENAI_API_KEY unset and no mock provider), Step 4 previously fell through to return { flagged: false, provider: 'rule_engine' }. This constituted a silent compliance bypass for all content passing local regex checks whenever the external provider was absent.
remediationSummary: Eliminated Step 4 fallback in apps/api/src/services/contentModeration.ts by throwing ModerationUnavailableError('Content moderation provider is not configured or unavailable'). All content requiring external moderation strictly fails closed (HTTP 503 MODERATION_UNAVAILABLE) without falsely marking content as violating policy, while preventing unmoderated publication.

semanticOutcomes.description: Provider is available and content is verified compliant with community standards.
Provider is available and content is flagged for policy violation (or violates local rules).
Provider missing, unconfigured, network down, or timed out; fail closed with HTTP 503 without falsely accusing user or permitting publication.

changes.summary: Defined ModerationUnavailableError class, timeout support, test mock hooks, and strict fail-closed exception throwing when external provider is absent, failed, or timed out.
Wrapped check-content endpoint in try-catch to return HTTP 503 MODERATION_UNAVAILABLE when ModerationUnavailableError is caught.

Corrected test path notation to apps/api/src/__tests__/moderation.test.ts; added TEST-W009-B3-01 through TEST-W009-B3-08 covering all 3 semantic states, timeout, network failure, local rules, publication safety, and explicit unconfigured/absent provider regression.

testResults.unconfiguredProviderTest: TEST-W009-B3-08 passing (HTTP 503, MODERATION_UNAVAILABLE, no false accusation, publication blocked)
